mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which is indicative of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which is supportive of equity markets and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative or neutral in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive or neutral in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases and UNRATE increases.
